name: aiwp-php-runner
description: Runs the PHP factory tools through a WebAssembly PHP build, for environments where installing a native PHP is not possible. On a normal dev machine use the real `php` binary instead.

scripts.test:integration: node license-integration.mjs ../../build/store-health "${AIWP_LICENSE_KEY:?set AIWP_LICENSE_KEY to a real key}" "${AIWP_PLATFORM_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:3000}"
